ROUTE_IDENTITY.detail: Retained from VF06 at 7d6453f51dacd9064f9a2b2d4d16618d0669add8 under exact current hash identity for the PDF/source/map/census/write/render inputs. Original measurement: One routeKey, obligation:track-pathway:MA:ma-seal-court:court-requested-sealing-for-dismissal-or-nolle-prosequi-100c, identical in production-field-map, source-receipt and the MASTER_QUEUE family row, and repeated in the guide's trailer. The instrument is the route: the delivered page 1 carries the court's own title PETITION TO SEAL CRIMINAL RECORDS FOR NOLLE PROSEQUI OR DISMISSAL and its own instruction 'Use this form to ask the court to seal criminal records for charges that resulted in a nolle prosequi or that the court dismissed', read off the delivered bytes. The guide draws the line the approval request asks about: it states that sealing limits who may see a record while expungement destroys it, that Massachusetts has a separate expungement petition under a different section, and that this packet is not it.

KNOWN_PREFILLS.detail: Retained from VF06 at 7d6453f51dacd9064f9a2b2d4d16618d0669add8 under exact current hash identity for the PDF/source/map/census/write/render inputs. Original measurement: Four writes, every one confirmed as ink in the delivered bytes and checked against the caption the form actually prints beside it, on both fixtures. Canonical: 'Jordan Avery Reyes' on the Your Name rule (x 110.7-, rect x 109.7 w 463.46), '1991-04-17' on Date of Birth, '42 Maple Street, Apartment 3' and 'Dorchester, MA 02124' on the two lines of the Address box captioned '(street, city, state, zip code)', and '617-555-0142' on Phone Number. Boundary writes the same four fields with the long-value fixture and nothing is refused or truncated: 'Unincorporated Township of Long Hollow Crossing, Massachusetts 01103-2214' runs to x 499.5 inside a box reaching 573.2. The map's composedMappings honestly declares that the Address box is written from two held facts. Nothing else on the form carries ink: the 111 charge cells, the nine narrative boxes, the docket number, the court division and the PCF number are all blank, which is the right answer on a petition signed under a perjury warning for a record the platform has never seen. Recorded, not scored as a failure: the date of birth is written in the platform's stored ISO form, 1991-04-17, on a Massachusetts Trial Court form whose Date of Birth box prints no order. It is unambiguous rather than wrong - no reader can take 1991 for a day - and the build-findings state the reasoning, but it is the only value on the page not in the local convention and a visual reviewer should see it.

PROTECTED_FIELDS.detail: Retained from VF06 at 7d6453f51dacd9064f9a2b2d4d16618d0669add8 under exact current hash identity for the PDF/source/map/census/write/render inputs. Original measurement: Three protected widgets and one trap, all clean. TextField1[2] (my signature) and DateField1[14] (the date you sign) on page 2 carry no ink, and the COURT ORDER block's single widget CheckBox5[1] is unticked and declared court-owned on the strength of the block's own printed caption '(for Court use only)', which I re-read from the binary at x 297-402 y 196.6. The trap is worth naming because it is the same class as the charge-table index defect: DateField1[14] is NAMED like a charge-table date cell and is in fact the signature date, sitting at rect [417.6 202.3 591.2 222.2] on page 2 directly under the printed 'DATE' at x 415 y 232.6 - so a builder that took every DateField1[*] as a disposition date would have written a charge date onto the signature line. I resolved it independently by geometry, it matches no printed row number, and the census classifies it protect with the label 'Date you sign the petition'. The court order block also prints a hearing date, a hearing time and a JUSTICE'S SIGNATURE line that carry no widget at all; nothing is drawn at any of them in the delivered bytes, checked over the whole page rather than only at widget rectangles.

FILING_DESTINATION.detail: Retained from VF06 at 7d6453f51dacd9064f9a2b2d4d16618d0669add8 under exact current hash identity for the PDF/source/map/census/write/render inputs. Original measurement: Answered better than most. The registry venue is quoted whole and then explained in the participant's own terms, and the unusual limb is called out: a District Court case goes back to the clerk's office where the case started, while a Boston Municipal Court case goes to the BMC division where the participant LIVES, or if they no longer live in BMC territory to the division the most recent eligible record is from. The guide puts that section before the COURT DIVISION/COUNTY blank and tells the participant to work the division out from the rule before writing it, which is the right order. 'Use a separate form for each case' is stated twice, once quoted from the form's own face. The destination the registry names, the clerk's office of the court identified by the venue rule, is what the guide names.

SERVICE.detail: Retained from VF06 at 7d6453f51dacd9064f9a2b2d4d16618d0669add8 under exact current hash identity for the PDF/source/map/census/write/render inputs. Original measurement: The right answer here is that the participant serves nobody, and the packet says so and says why. The registry records service as 'Per the court's practice on the form' and notice as the Clerk-Magistrate's act, and the delivered page 2 prints the court's own block: the Clerk-Magistrate must give notice of the hearing to the Probation Service and the appropriate prosecutor's office, who should notify any victims, and must post a copy of the petition on a public bulletin board until the hearing. The guide quotes that block verbatim and then states in terms that the route record records no service recipient, method or timing for this route and that what the form prints is that the Clerk-Magistrate gives the notices, not the participant, so nothing further is stated. It also surfaces the public-posting consequence in plain words before filing, which is the thing a participant would least expect. No service act, deadline or recipient is invented.

REPEATING_ROWS.detail: Retained from VF06 at 7d6453f51dacd9064f9a2b2d4d16618d0669add8 under exact current hash identity for the PDF/source/map/census/write/render inputs. Original measurement: MEASURED on the delivered bytes and on the pinned source, and this is the check this lane was asked to run. I reproduced the defect independently: reading every TextField3/DropDownList1/DateField1 rectangle out of the source AcroForm, and the printed row numbers out of the page text by position (rows 1-14 on page 1 at 27 pt pitch from y 427.5 down, rows 15-37 on page 3 from y 670.5 down), then resolving each cell to the one printed number whose band contains its centre. Result: 111 cells resolve to exactly one row each, and 52 OF THE 111 carry an AcroForm index that disagrees with the printed row - the same 52 the builder reported. The two worked examples match exactly: printed row 5 is TextField3[6] / DropDownList1[9] / DateField1[7], and printed row 13 is TextField3[12] / DropDownList1[1] / DateField1[12]. I then compared my geometric assignment against production-field-map's tableRow on all 111 cells: ZERO mismatches. So the build resolved every cell by the printed number and no cell is labelled for a row it does not sit on. A 112th cell carries a charge-table field name and belongs to no row - DateField1[14], the signature date on page 2 - and my resolver correctly matched it to no printed number; the census classifies it protect. Column identity is right too, and it was checked two independent ways: by x-position the middle heading at x 268-401 is 'State Whether the Court Entered a Nolle Prosequi or Dismissed the Charge' and the right heading at x 455-578 is 'Date of Nolle Prosequi or Dismissal', not the naive extracted line 'Charge Date of Nolle Prosequi or'; and the middle widget's own /Opt array reads ['', 'Nolle Prosequi', 'Dismissed'], which I read out of the binary. The delivered map writes the disposition label on the middle column and the date label on the right column, 37 of each, and the rendered page shows the three headings over the three columns as described. All 111 cells are delivered empty in both fixtures.
